public_rationale: Under the stated reading that medicine includes basic medical research, 'none' is too strong. AlphaFold had demonstrated its achievement in the [original study](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-021-03819-2.pdf) and received the [2023 Lasker Basic Medical Research Award](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1002331) before the post. This does not show that AI had delivered major cures or fulfilled the wider transformative promises. The proposal turns on that research-versus-clinical distinction.
limitations: Interpretation determines the result: restricting 'medicine' to delivered clinical benefits would remove this decisive counterexample.
